requiredFindings.title: The creator continuation cannot reach a store inside its one entry
requiredFindings.failureScenario: A creator command publishes, loses the race, or finds I not pristine. 468 r5 item 1 continues that same invocation through the durable write gate after dropping the attempt and InitialCore. X1 item 7 forbids admit_ordinary_writer in that process, because the one attempt and the one DurableWriteGate::begin are already spent. r4 says the invocation produces no endpoint and that X11 decides how the command reaches a store within those two constraints. AdmittedInstallation holds DurableInstallation and no session receipt, so item 1 has no selected core to join. OrdinaryWriteAdmission is the write producer that retains the receipt's InitialCore, and this process cannot enter it. PublishedInstallation.closure is the creator value 467 item 9 forbids promoting. The held fence has no SelectedStoreEndpoint, and a store use in that command either skips the core join or promotes the creator closure.

scope: Law X3a r4 amendment. Dropping InitialCore before the gate and refusing to carry the creator closure are consistent with 468 r5 item 1 and 467 item 9. RF-1: X11 cannot admit a store inside that same one entry. Live HEAD f7acb6d. No product cargo.
